mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX posts positive 20-day returns > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, defined as an increase of > 0.5pp in one month, signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spike trigger activates but SPX posts positive 5-day returns > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month for two consecutive periods, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS post 2-month declines but SPX returns are positive > 60% of the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will suppress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising trigger activates but SPX posts positive 60-day returns > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is accelerating, it signals a tight labor market that will boost wage growth and support consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS accelerating but SPX posts negative 20-day returns > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and rising for two consecutive months, it signals a strengthening industrial sector that will support S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and rising for 2 months but SPX posts negative 5-day returns > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing above 3% y-o-y and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, it signals a 'Goldilocks' economy that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 y-o-y growth > 3% and CPIAUCSL < 2% but SPX posts negative 60-day returns > 40% of the time.
